description: Filter Games view to show relevant events while preserving historical data

userStories.title: Filter GamesView to show upcoming and recent events
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see only upcoming games and recently finished games so I can focus on active betting.
acceptanceCriteria: GamesView shows events where status is NOT 'final' OR status IS 'final' AND finished within last 48 hours
Events sorted by start_time ascending (soonest first)
Old finished events are hidden but NOT deleted from database

userStories.title: Add Past Events toggle to GamesView
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to optionally view past events so I can review historical games.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Past': Shows events that are 'final' and older than 48 hours
Past events sorted by start_time descending (most recent first)

userStories.title: Ensure event details visible in bet history
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see event details when viewing a historical bet.
acceptanceCriteria: Bet rows/detail views show event info (teams, final score) for all bets
Handle case where bet references old event gracefully
No broken UI or crashes if event exists

userStories.title: Filter player game browsing to bettable events only
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see only upcoming games I can actually bet on.
acceptanceCriteria: Player's BetSlipSheet or game selection shows only events where status allows betting
Events with start_time in the past are hidden
Events with status 'final', 'locked', or 'canceled' are hidden
